versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00110 The buffering of sender-receiver communication shall be done on the receiver side. This does not imply that COM does no buffering on the sender side. On the receiver side, two different approaches are taken for the buffering of ‘data’ and of ‘events’, depending on the value of the software implementation policy.
